diagnostics.message: Avoid using !important as it makes styles harder to override
diagnostics.help: Use more specific selectors or reorganize CSS specificity instead

diagnostics.message: v-bind() installs runtime CSS variable updates
diagnostics.help: Vue lowers CSS v-bind() to per-instance reactive CSS custom property updates. Prefer static CSS, computed classes for finite variants, or a template :style binding when a prop-driven value is unavoidable.
